reference_syntax.source_key: For archival metric keys, select source_ref then exact dictionary key source_key
reference_syntax.assembled_ref: Historical original-assembly locator only. The excluded comparison_data blob is not a portable-validator dependency; public checks bind source reports directly to numeric manifests and approved renderer-generated TeX.
reference_syntax.family: Exact controller_families key in controller_protocol_provenance.json; resolves training protocol and all checkpoint identities
reference_syntax.inheritance: A table's panel, macro, bias, case count, gate, aggregation, source_adapter and value_scope apply to every row unless explicitly overridden
reference_syntax.values_manifest: For tables with value_scope, filter comparison_values by exact scope=value_scope AND family=row.family; one record per displayed metric. value and sd_value are unscaled source numbers; factor applies only when producing display/sd_display.
reference_syntax.raw_filter: Table raw_filter plus row.family selects the case records; mean bias and qualification bias scopes may differ
reference_syntax.pass: [qualified_policy_cases, planned_policy_cases], not the mean's case denominator

tex.release_use: Validate approved renderer-generated TeX; --tex accepts its repository-relative public locator without requiring this original file to be shipped

pid_reproduction_inventory.export_warning: Contains private-session absolute locations; sanitize locators or publish a scope-limited inventory, not private session contents

low.case_record_ancestry: Use low_case_records episode_path/source_summary/source_episode_registration_id. Non-Union original-peak rows reuse historical_control_summary; Union original-peak rows use union_regression_summary; Final-B uses final_b_summary.

confirmation.Q6_gate_aggregation: Add source_ref and zero_bias_source_ref qualified_count/episode_count; AND all_qualified and complete conditions

grid.definition: Stress-window mean independent nominal facility power minus controller facility power, excluding battery exchange
Stress-average grid-relief proxy, not actual peak reduction
Controller's own matched beta0.5 versus beta0 regulation revenue

quality.definition: Stress-window nominal-minus-controlled PCC import, including battery exchange
Absolute AC battery throughput across 24h service plus 2h recovery
26h actual regulation revenue minus metered electricity, relative to matched PID; not business profit
Difference of actual nominal/controller PCC maxima over service, not SPDR

latest.definition: Mean actual paid-service ratio; not the minimum used for all-case qualification
Difference of actual nominal/controller PCC maxima over full 26h; negative is not peak shaving

excluded_original_locator.portable_source: Frozen numeric means/sample_sds in this Q1 row map or an approved numeric-only derivative; do not require the excluded comparison_data blob or reopen the ZIP

cell_evidence_override.limit: Agreement verifies these rounded PID relief numbers, not every archival column, metric, checkpoint, or gate

rows.comparison: Reported own-controller bias effect, not cash versus PID

rows.source_key: Throughput reward change ($\Delta r_{\mathrm{thr}}$, per tick)
SOC reward change ($\Delta r_{\mathrm{soc}}$, per tick)
Thermal reward change ($\Delta r_{\mathrm{therm}}$, per tick)

tables.tex_caption_prefix: Observed inputs and operating powers in the reproduced PID runs
tables.interpretation_limit: Different realized trajectories, workload phase, random streams and physical bookkeeping. Billing alone, recovery after service and changed SAC weights do not explain this fixed-PID service-relief change.

tables.identity: stress_cooling_relief_mw + stress_other_facility_relief_mw = reported_formula_relief_mw in each mode and for the change

tables.tex_caption_prefix: Changing the macro alone on the same original peak cases
tables.value_manifest_coverage: Not included in comparison_values.json; must independently check these five derived rows
tables.interpretation: Within each row hardware checkpoint and cases are fixed; only an existing macro rule changes. Not learned bidding, not a superiority test, and not proof of global quantity optimality. No failed cases are removed.

tables.cross_architecture_limit: Low-level rows directly actuate hardware; economic/script rows add an allocator over an analytic executor. Their gap cannot be attributed wholly to learning. All source counts are retained, not replaced by a newly uniform gate.
tables.gate_label_caveat: The historical full-residual source actually enforces the 90% capacity floor. comparison_data.low_row's generic physical/recovery label and Q6 wording should not be read as evidence that these five source rows lacked it.

tables.primary_confirmed_contrast: potential_sac minus script_f100_always from original confirmation, not versus added PID

tables.interpretation: Zero-bias guardrail, not pooled with beta0.5; every displayed 26h peak-reduction mean is negative and must not be called peak shaving
Known peak dates with new noise only; Q6 and Q9 use identical neural weights, so changed absolute averages are not additional training improvements
Separate zero-bias descriptive panel; negative actual peak reductions are not peak shaving

tables.tex_caption_prefix: PID resource and reserve diagnostics, without survivor filtering
tables.value_manifest_coverage: Not included in comparison_values.json; source fields use mixed means, maxima and minima and need independent checks
tables.interpretation: All 440 cases meet the 90% paid-service floor and close recovery. Failures are the 24h end-SOC reserve only. Positive IT curtailment is an electrical-energy difference, not equivalent deferred work.

figure_Q1.interpretation: Descriptive complete-cohort progression; PID crosses diagnostic, diamonds fixed-four-checkpoint means, not deployed ensembles

portable_rebuild_boundary.reason: comparison_data.py original_table() and assemble() unconditionally open/hash the excluded original paper ZIP
portable_rebuild_boundary.numeric_renderer_contract: New numeric-only rebuild_numeric_tables.py uses approved numeric reports and this row map to generate CSV/HTML/table TeX. It does not use make_document(data), original assembly data, original TeX or paper prose. The approved nine-page PDF remains a frozen view, with no layout or byte-regeneration claim.
